description: This file provides centralized error handling for a Web API, mapping exceptions to standardized HTTP responses with ProblemDetails, logging, and diagnostic information.

classes.name: ApiErrorHandling
classes.description: Provides static methods for registering global exception handling middleware and converting exceptions into HTTP problem details responses.

methods.name: UseUnifiedExceptionHandling
methods.description: Sets up a global middleware to handle exceptions and convert them to ProblemDetails responses.

methods.name: ToResult
methods.description: Converts a caught exception into an IResult with a standardized ProblemDetails payload, including handling validation, not found, conflict, bad request, database configuration issues, and other errors.
